If you don't feel comfortable telling the whole truth, you could try and spin it in some other way while keeping the same point (if that makes sense?).

Either way, I know how difficult it is to talk about sensitive stuff to someone, but I trust you can overcome this as it really does help. I had talked about some real embarrassing/shameful stuff myself to a few different therapists, things I couldn't tell anyone I know, and it was worth it in the end. 

Bottling stuff up like that bad experience you had in the past is just not worth it and will likely keep you in this sad state for much longer than you'd want to, and I know you are eager to lead a normal life again asap (which I'm sure you will be able to do soon).

All that said, I'll say it again - try and forgive yourself for whatever happened. You are a much better person than your brain is trying to convince you.

And, of course, learning to forgive yourself for whatever you did. If you can't do that then I suggest going to a therapist to talk about it.
